svg.title: Glint public-web architecture
svg.desc: Three lanes show the foreground browser, authenticated long-running backend, and external services. Evidence, control feedback, and session-only key exchange have different line styles.
svg.text: Proposed production direction · October 27, 2026 · no deployment or performance claim
P = proposed G = capability gate U = user-reported test
HTTPS CDN assets; sign in first
SSRF, MIME, size and injection checks
Meta adapter resolves memory-only key ref
Meta adapter first; no invented endpoint
U: text / image success; one call 18.2 s
G: model ID, video, audio, rates, cost
Text / captions; STT + TTS are gated
Small original spark avatar; reduced motion
Private object store: consented clips only
No provider keys in either store
Clear input after submit; no browser storage
Key pays model calls, not Glint services
Raw key in process memory for provider calls
No logs, durable jobs, DB, object store, Redis
Separate quota, funding and privacy review
Public edge: static assets may cache; authenticated APIs, media and key exchange must not.
Long-running gateway + worker; durable progress survives restart, session-only keys do not. No turnkey hosted KV-cache control.
All numeric limits are proposed. Qualify accuracy, p95 guidance age, 60/90-minute device soaks, security, cost and concurrency before release.
